executive_summary:
# EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

A — PASS / PLAYER-SAFE HTTP BOUNDARY ESTABLISHED

The critical leak reproduced through real localhost TCP with experimental narration disabled and enabled. Explicit source-specific nested DTOs now exclude internal state from all registered /api JSON responses. 78 endpoint/fault HTTP requests and 50 one-shot developer-authored holdout cases contain zero hidden sentinel exposures; a separate ten-request raw-authority comparison passes for all five actions. The exact milestone sentence survives the final chat HTTP response; server stores and snapshots retain hidden information.

Development: 42 passed. Frozen holdout: 50/50 (developer-authored, not independent external validation). Focused: 893 passed / 3 failed. Boundary/frontend/persistence: 82 passed / 0 failed. Broader: 9 historical failures. New focused failures: 0. See regression report for identities and contract-test migration.

Browser verifies initial scene, structured investigation, existing exit travel, character/inventory and discovered-clue journal. Its milestone action button still displays a legacy refusal, while the exact fact appears in the journal. An offline entry-source comparison reproduces the identical refusal: preexisting and outside this projection repair. Five-action chat replay passes. This is not a claim of natural narration or universal semantic safety.

No commit or push. Zero live-provider requests. Existing narration validators, deterministic resolution and persistence owners were not changed. Primary next step: PR-PLAY-68: AI PRESENTATION ACCEPTANCE & NATURALNESS.

production: Explicit player HTTP nested DTOs; shared final JSON boundary and safe error responses.
validation: 42 development tests; existing private-metadata assertions migrated to server logs without removing authoritative checks.
tooling: Real TCP endpoint/replay/fault tests, one-shot frozen holdout, raw authority control and browser entry comparison.
documentation: 20 requested reports and canonical NEXT_SESSION orientation.
generated_artifacts: Redacted complete HTTP bodies, state/persistence evidence, provenance/hashes, latency and regression summaries.

testing.broader: 82 boundary/frontend/persistence checks; nine historical broader failures.
testing.full_suite: Not run; official ATGB not run.
testing.runtime_validation: 78 TCP endpoint/fault requests; 50 frozen HTTP holdout cases; ten raw-authority control requests; browser-originated core display/action/navigation smoke.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Zero live provider calls. Synthetic controlled narration only.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Three focused and nine broader historical failures. New Windows file-replacement failures preserved separately, with focused retry evidence.

decisions_requiring_human_review: No approval is required to review the repair. No commit, push, deployment or default flag enablement was performed.

pre_existing: Structured milestone button narration refusal remains identical in entry source; clue reaches the journal.
Three focused and nine broader historical failures.

missing_concepts: Item-level public visibility contracts for world factions/projects/events; natural optional presentation remains deferred.
does_not_prove: Universal semantic safety, independent external validation, official ATGB, live-provider quality, concurrent multi-tenant authorization, browser verification of every endpoint or client delivery ACK.
self_contained_review_test: 20 reports, redacted full HTTP schemas/bodies, exact replay, frozen manifest/results/hash, raw authority/persistence comparisons, endpoint/field contract, browser proof and incremental implementation diff.
